origin_hashes: PROVENANCE.json file_sha256 remains the immutable vendored input
scope: Keep registered transport capacity, main barriers/credits, hybrid dispatch and all main combine kernels unchanged.
Validate full-width real expert IDs and duplicate experts before route-derived indexing in both direct-dispatch routing loops; preserve -1 padding and destination-rank deduplication.
Fuse only noncached, nondeterministic role dispatch in one logical NVLink domain; deterministic and other logical paths retain the separate route guard and completion helpers.
Assert every incoming source count is zero in the main notify phase; use existing normal stream events and tensor lifetimes instead of empty-side completion kernels on the fused path.
Allocate no source receive rows; bound worker receive rows by explicit source count.
Read actual device counts after reducing allocation bounds; preserve hybrid forwarding metadata.
Known-empty sources return zero host counts without CPU polling or per-dispatch host counter clears; device counter resets and launch flags remain unchanged.
Expose compiled and loaded NCCL versions for startup compatibility checks.

v2.1: on the role-aware direct-NVLink path every rank instantiates combine with expected top-k ceil(top_k/ffn_ranks) and maximum reduction unroll 2; generic instantiations omit these defaulted template arguments and keep the upstream kernel.

v2.1 screening aid (default off): AFDEP_SKIP_ENTRY_BARRIERS removes the dispatch/combine entry barriers on every role-path rank together; AFDEP_COMBINE_EXPECTED_TOPK/AFDEP_COMBINE_MAX_UNROLL override the combine defaults.
